🐦 TLDR on BTC:

LTF — ~65 interim pivot w/ confluence to take out previous week high and leg up or roll-over. Monday NY session important.

Medium-term: BTC remains in counter-trend rally (HTF downtrend, LTF reversion lacking decisive momentum)

HTF — Conventional cycle: another few months of bear. Optimistic case: sideways chop for a while.
